svg.text: Original v0.13 paths and pen start/end indicators
Filled blue markers = starts; hollow marks = ends; large black dot is glyph artwork
40. G071 / G072 — Curved return + upper branch
41. G073 / G074 — Curved return + separate solid dot
42. G064 / G065 — Hooked sweep + crossing line
